_comment: THE pricing seed: the only place in the repo where a SortMyCover price is typed (3.6). Loaded into the Postgres `pricing` table by `node automation/billing/pricing.js --sql`. Every other surface reads the table. Values from MASTER-PROMPT 3.5. active_from stays null until Jonathan approves the ladder (Section 8 Q5); W25 renders unapproved rows only in staging. media_share_zar = the 3.5 'Media @ R200 CPL (incl. VAT)' column as written, matching media-buyer's campaign-spec; whether Meta's budget should be that figure or that figure / 1.15 (Meta adds VAT on top) is needs_human NH-BA-03. ref_code is the one-letter tier token used in payment references (needs_human NH-BA-02).
_comment_terms: terms / topup / qualified_lead: Jonathan's decisions of 2026-10-05 (deliverables/contracts-drafter/lead-generation-agreement/BRIEF.md). Read by src/lib/pricing.ts (website /pricing, proposal + invoice generators, public chatbot) and by supabase/functions/_shared/pricing.generated.ts (regenerate with `node automation/billing/gen-edge-pricing.mjs`). Prices excl. VAT; vat_registered=false means no VAT line.
_comment_replacement_cap_cycle: rows[].replacement_cap_cycle (4 / 6 / 9) is NOT the published or contractual replacement rule. It is the internal per-cycle allowance that the W13 claim SQL snapshots into cycles.replacement_cap (migrations smc_02_core / smc_06_pass2) and the costing assumption in MASTER-PROMPT 3.5 (about 20% of committed leads). The rule every surface prints is terms.goodwill_replacements_per_week: goodwill, 3 requests per Calendar Week on every Plan including the Pilot (agreement clause 7.2; MASTER-PROMPT 0.1), no-shows and uncontactable leads counted together. No surface may print replacement_cap_cycle. Moving W13 and cycles from the per-cycle allowance to the weekly rule needs a migration and a W13 change: deliverables/contracts-drafter/lead-generation-agreement/open-items.md section 8.

terms.shortfall_after_rollover: after day 44 (30-day cycle + up to 14 days only for delays outside our control), undelivered leads roll into the next cycle on top of its committed number; or the client may ask at any time after day 44 for a refund of the effective price per undelivered lead, paid within 7 working days of the request
terms.late_payment: delivery suspended until paid; no interest

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot._comment: Jonathan 2026-10-05: once-off introductory 30-day cycle, first-time clients only; price = price_per_lead_zar x committed_leads; flat fee in advance; same rollover and goodwill-replacement rules. Withdrawn 2026-10-07, reinstated 2026-10-10 (Jonathan): `offered` is the switch every surface reads (src/lib/pricing.ts PILOT_OFFERED); after the Pilot the client continues on Bronze or higher, otherwise the agreement ends. Kept outside `rows` so the monthly ladder (checkout, W25, Paystack plans) is unchanged. media_share_zar not decided.
